facts.text: The poster over our bar. Some nights it's all anybody looks at.
facts.why: In the film Carlito stares at a billboard with a Caribbean beach as he dies at Grand Central. The plot says nothing about a poster over the bar at El Paraiso.
facts.fix: The poster at Grand Central. Carlito can't stop looking at it.

facts.text: Paradise flan -- caramel and coconut, for the beach postcard Carlito keeps
facts.why: The plot has a billboard of a Caribbean beach at the end and train tickets to Miami. It does not mention a postcard that Carlito keeps.
facts.fix: Paradise flan -- caramel and coconut, for the beach billboard Carlito stares at

vibe.verdict: A warm, moody club and train ticket menu that gets Carlito's dream of the islands right. The poster caption is the only spot that moves the film around.
missing: Benny Blanco from the Bronx (the club)
The billboard coming to life (the final shot)
ideas: Fix the poster caption to point at the Grand Central billboard
Swap 'One last temptation' for a Gail line about the ballet
Add a Benny Blanco 'from the Bronx' line to the bar, replacing 'Piña colada' plain note
